source.description: Synthetic two warmup and five evaluation session closes and separate synthetic execution snapshots; no external market data.

semantics.prices: Synthetic unadjusted daily closes are available at 15:05 local; separate point snapshots are available after acceptance and never represent minute OHLCV. Money uses exact four-decimal CNY; fixed fee is charged per Fill. Sell proceeds are unsettled until the next listed synthetic session.
qualityCases: BUY SELL HOLD and next-session cash settlement

expectedAssertions.description: One scoped backend run uses two warmup and five evaluation sessions to generate BUY, SELL and HOLD, with exact fills, ledger and independent reconciliation.
BUY leaves 8970 CNY; SELL leaves 995 CNY pending; next session settles to 9965 CNY without duplicate ledger entries.
Missing or invalid inputs, mandate and execution-window failures are paused without orders, fills or reservations.
Original identities survive lost responses or worker termination without duplicate target, order, fill, ledger or alert.
Web and read-only CLI check the same persisted Run and expose actual task, decision and reconciliation facts.
